name: Ticket flow
purpose: Advance a support request through steps, capture notes in a form, and record events on a timeline.
scenarios: Add a note from a form
Advance to the next stage and append a timeline event

locale.description: BCP 47 locale for bundled block copy.

currentStep.description: Current stage: open, triage, progress, or resolved.

onNote.description: Called after a note is appended.

onAdvance.description: Called after the ticket moves to the next stage.

variants.name: density
variants.description: Inherits density from token rungs rather than a local viewport query.

states.name: default
states.description: The ticket has notes and is not resolved.

antiPatterns: Do not skip the form when capturing notes; unlabeled free text is not a ticket trail.
Do not claim 21 authored languages; 19 locales are ICU skeletons.

keyboard: Tab reaches advance, steps, and the note form
a11y.focus: Actions stay in document order with a visible focus ring.
a11y.labeling: Steps have an accessible name; the note field has a visible label.

responsive.strategy: Header wraps with flex; steps use the component's own @container queries. No viewport media queries in this block.

breakpoints.compact: Header stacks; steps stack inside the steps component.
breakpoints.medium: Header sits on one row when space allows.
breakpoints.large: Header sits on one row when space allows.

rtl.strategy: Logical CSS only. Direction comes from locale language.
